service.description: Resolves an image from DeviceContent, calls an OpenVLA-compatible visual grounding endpoint, and optionally persists the geometric result as Vector / VectorComponent records. The returned targetPose can be passed directly as goalPose to run#RobotArmTrajectoryPlanner.

return.message: No image DeviceContent found for device ${deviceId}

if.script:
def createVector = { String name, String description, String vectorSpaceEnumId, String purposeEnumId, List<BigDecimal> values -> if (!values) return null def vectorValue = ec.entity.makeValue("moqui.math.Vector") vectorValue.setAll([ vectorTypeEnumId: "VtOrdinary", purposeEnumId: purposeEnumId, vectorSpaceEnumId: vectorSpaceEnumId, name: name, description: description, dimension: values.size() ]) vectorValue.setSequencedIdPrimary() vectorValue.create() values.eachWithIndex { BigDecimal value, int idx -> def componentValue = ec.entity.makeValue("moqui.math.VectorComponent") componentValue.setAll([ vectorId: vectorValue.vectorId, dimensionIndex: idx, componentTypeEnumId: "VctCanonical", realValue: value ]) componentValue.setSequencedIdPrimary() componentValue.create() } return vectorValue.vectorId }
if (saveBoundingBox && boundingBox) { boundingBoxMinVectorId = createVector( "bbox_min_${deviceId}", "Visual grounding bounding-box min corner for device ${deviceId}, image ${deviceContent.deviceContentId}", imageVectorSpaceEnumId ?: "EuclideanSpace2D", "VpPosition", [boundingBox[0], boundingBox[1]] ) boundingBoxMaxVectorId = createVector( "bbox_max_${deviceId}", "Visual grounding bounding-box max corner for device ${deviceId}, image ${deviceContent.deviceContentId}", imageVectorSpaceEnumId ?: "EuclideanSpace2D", "VpPosition", [boundingBox[2], boundingBox[3]] ) } if (saveCenter && center) { centerVectorId = createVector( "bbox_center_${deviceId}", "Visual grounding center point for device ${deviceId}, image ${deviceContent.deviceContentId}", imageVectorSpaceEnumId ?: "EuclideanSpace2D", "VpPosition", center ) } if (saveTargetPose && targetPose) { targetPoseVectorId = createVector( "target_pose_${deviceId}", "Target TCP pose inferred from visual grounding for device ${deviceId}, image ${deviceContent.deviceContentId}", targetPoseVectorSpaceEnumId ?: "EngTcpPose6Dof", "VpPosition", targetPose ) }

service.description:
Run a 6-DOF robot TCP waypoint planner using a DJL ONNX model.
The model accepts [tcp_start(6) || tcp_goal(6)] (12 inputs) and produces N_WAYPOINTS x 6 TCP poses (flat output), aligned with the PLC waypoint space used by PLCopen Part 4 coordinated-motion FBs such as MC_MoveLinearAbsolute and MC_MoveCircularAbsolute.
Persists results to: Vector / VectorComponent — per-waypoint TCP poses + tcp_start/tcp_goal ApproximatedFunction — parent function container ParametricPath — path-level metadata Trajectory — time-tagged motion ApproximatedFunctionSample — one sample per waypoint ParametricPathPoint — path point per sample TrajectoryPoint — time offset per sample MathModelRun — execution record MathModelPerf — latency / throughput counters MathModelData — links model to trajectory + input vectors
The ONNX model file is resolved from MathModelDefContent.contentLocation (e.g. component://moqui-device/data/ml/trajectory_planner.onnx). The current bundled model must be retrained/exported in the same TCP pose space (X,Y,Z,A,B,C) to match this service contract.

parameter.name: mathModelId
parameter.description: ID of the MathModel instance to use for inference.

parameter.name: startPose
parameter.description: 6 TCP pose values [X,Y,Z,A,B,C] — start pose in the same space used by the PLC.

parameter.name: goalPose
parameter.description: 6 TCP pose values [X,Y,Z,A,B,C] — goal pose in the same space used by the PLC.

set.from: [mathModelId: mathModelId, startTime: ec.user.nowTimestamp, parameters: mathModelRunParameters, hasError: 'N']

[vectorSpaceEnumId: 'EngTcpPose6Dof', codomainTypeEnumId: 'AfctVector', dataStorageEnumId: 'AfdsPointTable', purposeEnumId: 'AfpRobotMotion', interpolationEnumId: 'AfiAIPath', name: trajectoryLabel, description: '6-DOF TCP waypoint trajectory from AI planner']
[vectorId: waypointVectorId, dimensionIndex: poseIndex, componentTypeEnumId: 'VctCanonical', realValue: poseValue]

[approximatedFunctionId: approximatedFunctionId, sampleCode: 'WP' + String.format('%04d', waypointIndex), sampleName: 'Waypoint ' + waypointIndex, sequenceNum: waypointIndex, sampleTypeEnumId: sampleTypeEnumId, sampleVectorId: waypointVectorId]
[approximatedFunctionId: approximatedFunctionId, approximatedFunctionSampleId: sampleId, pointTimeOffsetMillis: waypointIndex * stepMs]
[vectorId: inputVectorValue.vectorId, dimensionIndex: poseIndex, componentTypeEnumId: 'VctCanonical', realValue: poseValue]
[mathModelId: mathModelId, dataTypeEnumId: 'MmdtApproxFunc', purposeEnumId: 'MmdpModelOutputs', generatedByRunId: runId, approximatedFunctionId: approximatedFunctionId, sequenceNum: 1]
[mathModelId: mathModelId, dataTypeEnumId: 'MmdtVector', purposeEnumId: 'MmdpModelInputs', generatedByRunId: runId, vectorId: startVectorId, sequenceNum: 2]
[mathModelId: mathModelId, dataTypeEnumId: 'MmdtVector', purposeEnumId: 'MmdpModelInputs', generatedByRunId: runId, vectorId: goalVectorId, sequenceNum: 3]

actions.script:
import groovy.json.JsonOutput
long elapsed = System.currentTimeMillis() - t0 double totalDurationSec = elapsed > 0 ? elapsed / 1000.0d : 0.001d resultsJson = JsonOutput.toJson([approximatedFunctionId: approximatedFunctionId, waypointCount: waypointCount])
def runRef = ec.entity.find("moqui.math.MathModelRun").condition("mathModelRunId", runId).one() runRef.setAll([endDate : ec.user.nowTimestamp, runningTimeMillis : (float) elapsed, approximatedFunctionId: approximatedFunctionId, results : resultsJson]) runRef.update()
perfFields = [mathModelRunId: runId, totalDurationSec: totalDurationSec, inferenceLatencyMs: inferenceLatencyMs as double, throughputSamplesSec: (waypointCount as double) / totalDurationSec]
